ecs.name: ECS (Entity Component System)
ecs.description: Arch ECS framework with components and systems

game-states.name: Game States
game-states.description: State machine for game modes, menus, and lobby

networking.name: Networking
networking.description: Multiplayer networking with host-authoritative P2P model and MessagePack serialization

rendering.name: Rendering
rendering.description: Sprite rendering, animation, camera, and procedural shape generation (SkiaSharp)

ai.name: AI System
ai.description: Enemy AI behaviors and enemy archetype designs

combat.name: Combat
combat.description: Combat, projectiles, abilities, damage, ghost mode, and deterministic RNG

turbo.name: Turbo System
turbo.description: 3-bar turbo gauge: dodge (i-frames, destructible breaking) and hold-to-charge abilities (TurboShot, StompAoE, TurboBall)

damage.name: Damage Authority
damage.description: Host-authoritative damage validation and health synchronization

boss.name: Boss Fight Framework
boss.description: Multi-phase boss fights with attack pools, minion spawning, enrage, vulnerability, and shield mechanics

dungeon-generation.name: Procedural Dungeon Generation
dungeon-generation.description: BSP + Graph-based procedural dungeon generator for Adventure mode

input.name: Input
input.description: Input handling with keyboard, mouse, and gamepad support including isometric rotation

aiming.name: Aiming System
aiming.description: Mouse/gamepad aiming with isometric coordinate transforms, camera timing, and network determinism

devtools.name: Developer Tools
devtools.description: CLI utilities for testing, debugging, dungeon preview, HUD preview, headless rendering, layout validation, screenshot capture, and entity state dumping

dungeon-debug.name: Dungeon Debug & Export
dungeon-debug.description: In-game debug overlay rendering, dungeon export to PNG/text/JSON, metadata logging

debug-console.name: Debug Console
debug-console.description: In-game debug console for testing and development (F12 or backtick to toggle)

tiled-templates.name: Tiled Room Templates
tiled-templates.description: Hand-crafted room templates from Tiled Map Editor for dungeon generation

content.name: Content & Assets
content.description: Asset loading and management, art pipeline (Meshy, Blender, atlas packing)

audio.name: Audio System
audio.description: Sound effect loading, playback, and WAV generation for MonoGame

collectibles.name: Collectible System
collectibles.description: Instant and permanent pickup effects: StatScroll, Food, Stopwatch, LevelUpBook, APOrb. Drops from enemies via JSON-driven drop tables.

core-fusion.name: Core & Fusion System
core-fusion.description: Equipment system: Orbs + Mods fused into Cores. PowerLevel (1-5) on all items via augment tokens. SlotBasedEquipment (3+3 slots).

ui.name: UI Framework
ui.description: Unified UI drawing primitives, color palette, scaling, HUD widgets, overlays, and NinePatch panels

vacuum-pickups.name: Vacuum Pickup System
vacuum-pickups.description: XP crystals and gold bags with Vampire Survivors-style vacuum physics (burst → float → attract → collect)

retrieval.task: fix camera offset

files_for_first_match.name: Rendering
files_for_first_match.description: Sprite rendering, animation, camera, and procedural shape generation (SkiaSharp)

retrieval.task: Repair multiplayer snapshot serialization.
Investigate why client snapshots are not sent through the transport.
Fix interpolation and snapshot synchronization for online multiplayer.
Why are sprite textures blurred in the animation?
Update the camera draw order for sprite animation.
Sprites and textures flicker.
Fix collision and raycast behavior when an obstacle blocks the path.
Why do raycasts miss obstacles?
Enemy AI should chase and then flee from the target.
Repair enemies that wander before aggro.
Fix projectile damage and weapon attack timing.
Projectiles and weapons fire but deal no damage.
Fix the keyboard and gamepad controls for WASD movement.
Support multiple controllers and keyboards.
Repair the UI tooltip and progress bar overlay.
The music starts twice after loading a saved game.
Raycasts stop at empty doorways in the latest build.
Survival mode hangs when leaving the lobby.
Headless screenshot output is black at 1920x1080.
A single trigger press sometimes makes the rifle fire two projectiles instead of one.
The gamepad fails to reconnect after I unplug it.
The tooltip remains on screen after closing the dialog.
In the latest build, the gamepad stops responding after reconnecting.
The client applies the same snapshot twice after reconnecting.
The player loses keyboard control when a second gamepad connects.
The health bar is the wrong color. The health value is correct.
